testPattern.name: source-grounded sentence timestamp alignment
testPattern.redContract: For every published sentence, overlap its time range with raw-ASR segments, normalize both texts, and require a bounded text alignment score plus source hash/model metadata. Fail when the best matching source window is outside the published range or the score is below threshold.
negativeFixtures: shift a sentence timestamp onto an adjacent sentence
replace a sentence with a same-length but different source span
remove raw-ASR provenance or source hash
leave a large unexplained inter-sentence gap
testPattern.failClosed: missing audio/raw-ASR is BLOCKED; available source with text/time mismatch is FAIL; only source-grounded alignment may PASS
